headline: 卡里普索之王91歲辭世
context: 千里達歌手法蘭西斯柯（Slinger Francisco），藝名Mighty Sparrow，有「世界卡里普索之王」美譽。他已於9月27日辭世，享耆壽91歲，家人說他是在紐約由親人陪伴下安詳離世。他1956年以歌曲《Jean and Dinah》嶄露頭角。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Slinger Francisco, who performed as the Mighty Sparrow, died on Sunday surrounded by family in New York Slinger Francisco, known on stage as the Mighty Sparrow and dubbed the “calypso king of the world”, has died aged 91. Francisco, who got his breakthrough in calypso music with his 1956 hit song Jean and Dinah, died peacefully surrounded by his family in New York on Sunday, his family said in a statement. sources.title: Mighty Sparrow, the Trinidad and Tobago singer known as the ‘calypso king of the world’, dies aged 91

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Trinidadian singer and songwriter hailed as a living legend and the greatest calypsonian of all time The singer and songwriter Mighty Sparrow, who has died aged 91, was quite simply the greatest calypsonian there has ever been. For at least five decades he was a monumental figure on the Caribbean music scene, while also capturing the hearts and minds of millions of fans around the world with self-penned songs that were the quintessential calypso mix of political commentary, humour, sexual innuendo and melody. Loved and feted by Trinidadians more than any other public figure in the island’s history, he was to calypso what Bob Marley was to reggae – an inspirational living legend. In Britain, no less than elsewhere, the sheer wit and quality of classic songs such as Jean and Dinah , Congo Man and Mae Mae brought calypso to many who would never otherwise have encountered the music form, particularly in the 1950s, 60s and 70s, when he was in his prime. threads_text:
「世界卡里普索之王」辭世，享耆壽91歲

千里達歌手法蘭西斯柯（Slinger Francisco），藝名Mighty Sparrow，已於9月27日在紐約辭世，享耆壽91歲，家人說他是由親人陪伴下安詳離世。他1956年以歌曲《Jean and Dinah》嶄露頭角，此後半世紀間是加勒比海樂壇的重量級人物，作品融合政治評論、幽默與旋律，被形容是卡里普索音樂界的傳奇人物。

本則整理自衛報於 2026 年 9 月 28 日發佈的報導。
voice_text: 有「世界卡里普索之王」美譽的歌手法蘭西斯柯過世了，享耆壽91歲。他藝名Mighty Sparrow，9月27日在紐約由家人陪伴下安詳離世。他1956年以歌曲《Jean and Dinah》嶄露頭角，往後半世紀是加勒比海樂壇的重量級人物。
